name: flutter-specialist
title_zh: 非平凡 Flutter 架构问题才接单的资深审阅
tagline_zh: 别拿改字体颜色来烦它。状态管理、导航、生命周期、原生插件、IAP、深链、离线、渲染性能——这些它才上手。
tagline_en: Don't bother it with font colors. State, navigation, lifecycle, plugins, IAP, deep links, offline, rendering—it.
desc_en: Senior Flutter/Dart specialist for non-trivial architecture, state management, repositories, navigation, lifecycle, native plugins, IAP, deep links, offline behavior, rendering/performance, testing, or platform debugging. Do not invoke for trivial widget text/style edits.
why_zh: 它先判断问题是否够格，再决定是否介入——避免大炮打蚊子，也保证真刀真枪的架构难题有资深视角兜底。
why_en: It gates on problem depth before engaging—so trivial edits don't waste its firepower, and real architectural knots get.
limit_zh: 只接非平凡架构问题；纯 widget 样式/文案微调会直接拒绝。需要你已具备 Flutter 基础，它不教语法。
limit_en: Only non-trivial architecture; trivial widget/style edits are refused. Requires basic Flutter knowledge—no syntax tutoring. Outputs reviews/plans.
title_en: Senior Flutter review for non-trivial architecture only
